rules.message: No model clears the capability and policy gates.
High-consequence work requires human and domain review.
Regulated work cannot be autonomously approved.
Sensitive or protected data requires privacy and security review.
Pricing is outside the approved freshness window.
The estimate contains assumptions that the decision owner must confirm.
The workflow defines more than eight primary and checker steps per completed task before retries.
More than twenty primary and checker steps per completed task before retries exceeds the alpha control limit.
One or more deterministic evaluation cases failed.
Independent cost recomputation did not match.
No evidence-qualified model fits the stated cost-per-completed-task ceiling. Change the workflow, ceiling, or requirements before proceeding.
Unknown consequences of error require human review before approval.
Unknown regulatory status requires human review before approval.
An uncertain model job requires human review before approval.
Output-length and retry distributions are planning heuristics, not measured production behavior. Calibrate them with repeated live evaluations before using the range as a committed budget.
